notes.title: SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream Demo Version Released
notes.notes:
The demo for SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream has been released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3319640/

Play as select characters from the roster and try the Co-Op Quest and  Boss Raid! Challenge Illfang the Kobold Lord and The Skull Reaper together with other demo players!

Take a look at the System Trailer for more details on the game systems!
